CustomField.description: Optional URL of an embedded interactive guide (e.g. a Scribe share link). The help center renders it as a full-width frame below the article body. Pasting iframe HTML into the rich-text body does not work — Salesforce strips iframes on save — so embeds go through this field.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Optional: paste an embed URL (e.g. a Scribe share link, https://scribehow.com/embed/…). It renders as an interactive frame below the article body.
CustomField.label: Embed URL
